name: Admin Hour Packages — Configuración
description: Admin opens the Configuración section of /panel/hour-packages: edits the per-nationality base hourly rates (COL/EXT/USA) and saves — PATCH /api/hour-packages/admin/settings/update/ propagates the rate to every package of that nationality and the catalog reflects it; invalid rates (<= 0) are rejected client-side and a server failure surfaces an error toast. Also saves the default view mode and restores one nationality's catalog to the canonical DEFAULT_PACKAGES ladder behind a ConfirmModal (POST /api/hour-packages/admin/restore-defaults/, destructive replace; restore also resets that nationality's base rate).
